import { flushSync } from "react-dom";
import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";
import { ReactArrayBoard } from "../react_array.tsx";
import { jsx as _jsx } from "react/jsx-runtime";
export function mountReact(container, initialIds, life) {
	const root = createRoot(container);
	let setIds = null;
	const registerIdsSetter = (setter) => {
		if (setIds !== null) throw new Error("duplicate React setter");
		setIds = setter;
		return () => {
			if (setIds === setter) setIds = null;
		};
	};
	try {
		flushSync(() => root.render(/* @__PURE__ */ _jsx(ReactArrayBoard, {
			initialIds,
			life,
			registerIdsSetter
		})));
	} catch (error) {
		try {
			flushSync(() => root.unmount());
		} catch (disposeError) {
			throw new Error(`React mount failed: ${String(error)}; disposal failed: ${String(disposeError)}`);
		}
		throw error;
	}
	return {
		click(id) {
			const node = [...container.querySelectorAll("li[data-id]")].find((item) => item.dataset.id === id);
			if (!node) throw new Error(`missing click target ${id}`);
			flushSync(() => node.click());
		},
		edit(_edit, next) {
			if (!setIds) throw new Error("React setter unregistered");
			flushSync(() => setIds(next));
			return {};
		},
		dispose() {
			flushSync(() => root.unmount());
			return {
				readerCount: null,
				ownerCount: null,
				setterRegistered: setIds !== null
			};
		}
	};
}
